prompt_claim: Reset produced genuinely fresh ideas
correction_or_boundary: At least five of seven retained concepts duplicate or re-underwrite existing canonical/staged/research records.

prompt_claim: Seven named Member States are piloting in 2026
correction_or_boundary: France Denmark Greece Italy Spain Cyprus and Ireland are named front-runners.

prompt_claim: Full EU rollout expected by end of 2026
correction_or_boundary: Official portal says pilot in 2026 ahead of general availability; no end-2026 full-rollout commitment was found.

prompt_claim: Verifier must support DC API and OID4VP with standard mdoc and ZKP
correction_or_boundary: The guide describes two presentation mechanisms and two proof types and requires all combinations.

prompt_claim: Commission reference verifier is not production ready
correction_or_boundary: Official repositories call components development tools or not intended for production use; the white-label app is incomplete and needs integration.

prompt_claim: All 14 proposed chaos scenarios can be executed now across national wallets
correction_or_boundary: The matrix is a test design. Access to implementations test credentials revocation controls and authorized staging endpoints has not been demonstrated.

prompt_claim: AgeGate Replay is a fresh idea
correction_or_boundary: Merge into canonical idea-309 AgeGate Chaos Lab and prior AgeProof Lab / EUDI Real-World Regression Cloud research.

prompt_claim: Official conformance work leaves production-journey testing outside its boundary
correction_or_boundary: FCAF is reusable formal functional conformance and documents test-specification gaps; commercial demand for a separate journey lab remains unproven.

prompt_claim: YC Fall 2026 requested a cloud for Small Software
correction_or_boundary: YC explicitly identifies auth permissions and safe sharing of arbitrary code as hard problems.

prompt_claim: 90 percent of AI-built apps remain on localhost
correction_or_boundary: No source or measurement was supplied or found; remove the statistic.

prompt_claim: SmallSoft Gate is a fresh idea
correction_or_boundary: It directly re-underwrites canonical idea-359 Small-Software Deployment Cloud; the security controls are a feature hypothesis.

prompt_claim: The secure-runtime layer has little existing substitution
correction_or_boundary: Vercel Cloudflare and Modal offer isolated untrusted-code sandboxes and Replit offers private deployment access controls.

prompt_claim: Council adopted a negotiating position on European Business Wallets on 9 June 2026
correction_or_boundary: Legislation remains in process; this is not an enacted production requirement.

prompt_claim: MandateMesh is fresh
correction_or_boundary: Duplicate of idea-341 EntityMandate and adjacent idea-344 MandateCompiler.

prompt_claim: Grid measures could unlock 1200-1600 GW and non-firm agreements 750-900 GW
correction_or_boundary: These are IEA global estimates of advanced-stage queued projects not the addressable market for a software product.

prompt_claim: The Netherlands BESS case found fee savings can outweigh curtailed revenue
correction_or_boundary: The paper reports a 65 percent grid-fee reduction in its case and sensitivity to price data and curtailment timing; it does not generalize to every agreement.

prompt_claim: Modo already models flexible-connection restrictions
correction_or_boundary: Modo accepts uploaded time-varying import/export limits and compares constrained and unconstrained forecasts.

prompt_claim: NonFirm Replay is fresh
correction_or_boundary: Overlaps staged GridSlot and prior CurtailmentCost Replay; retain only a narrower independent contract-review experiment.

prompt_claim: Articles 6-9 of Regulation 2025/1569 apply from 19 August 2026
correction_or_boundary: The regulation requires provider lists and catalogues with automated/human-readable access and signed or sealed publication controls.

prompt_claim: Every contemplated trust feed is already live and populated
correction_or_boundary: The application date is verified; current operational population and change cadence of each feed were not demonstrated.

prompt_claim: TrustList Sentry is fresh
correction_or_boundary: The legacy corpus already contains TrustList Drift with the same monitoring object.

prompt_claim: YC identifies agents robots and humans as three worker types in field services
correction_or_boundary: The handoff-receipt product is an analyst inference rather than customer evidence.

prompt_claim: FieldHandoff has demonstrated a distinct paid wedge
correction_or_boundary: Treat as a feature hypothesis adjacent to idea-279 RobotOps and Robot Skill Acceptance until a vertical workflow and buyer artifact exist.

prompt_claim: One anonymous contractor anecdote establishes recurring demand
correction_or_boundary: It is pain evidence only and cannot establish prevalence willingness to pay or differentiation.

prompt_claim: The product can state the exact date cash reaches zero
correction_or_boundary: Receivable timing is uncertain; return scenario ranges probability bands and assumptions.

prompt_claim: The job-level wedge has thin competition
correction_or_boundary: Float offers 13-week views and scenario planning; Cash Flow Frog and Dryrun offer forecasting/scenarios; Siteline provides construction billing and cash-flow forecasting.

prompt_claim: DPP Registry launched with a testing environment
correction_or_boundary: The Commission also describes API registration semantic repository verification framework and logging.

prompt_claim: CRA reporting begins 11 September 2026
correction_or_boundary: Manufacturers must report actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents from that date.

prompt_claim: Contingency identifiers start on 15 October 2026
correction_or_boundary: The contingency provisions entered with the regulation; 15 October applies only to Article 1(2)(c) on attribution of due-diligence statements.

prompt_claim: Scores from 6.3 to 8.4 are evidence-backed rankings
correction_or_boundary: No scoring rubric calculation buyer evidence or uncertainty interval was supplied. Preserve only as analyst estimates outside ranking authority.
